```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "fcde82a2-4252-45d0-8cba-27fdb662acac",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-61c497b0-2ecc-4923-8f83-6135ba6bbf19",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Batch 7: Final batch - remaining topics\n$batch7 = @(\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is flexible retirement?\"; content = \"Flexible or partial retirement allows you to reduce your working hours and start drawing some pension while continuing to work part-time.&#96;n&#96;nAvailability: Subject to employer agreement. Check with your HR department if this is available in your role.&#96;n&#96;nHow it works: You draw part of your pension while continuing to build up further benefits on your remaining salary.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Tax implications may apply, and your pension projection will change.\"; keywords = \"flexible retirement,partial retirement,part-time,phased\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I retire and be re-employed?\"; content = \"Yes, it is possible to retire, start drawing your pension, and then be re-employed.&#96;n&#96;nConsiderations:&#96;n- You cannot rejoin the UUKPF DB section after retirement&#96;n- If re-employed, you may be enrolled in the Investing Plan (DC section)&#96;n- There may be tax implications, particularly around Annual Allowance&#96;n&#96;nYou should seek advice on the implications before proceeding with this arrangement.\"; keywords = \"re-employment,retire,continue working\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is a small pot lump sum?\"; content = \"If your total pension is very small, you may be able to take it as a one-off lump sum instead of a regular pension.&#96;n&#96;nTrival commutation: If your total benefits from all sources are below a de minimis limit (currently around £30,000), you may be able to commute your entire pension to a lump sum.&#96;n&#96;nSmall pot: Individual small pension pots (under £10,000) may be taken as a lump sum.&#96;n&#96;nTax: 25% is tax-free, 75% is taxable.\"; keywords = \"small pot,trivial commutation,lump sum,de minimis\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What if I have a complaint?\"; content = \"If you are unhappy with any aspect of your pension, you should:&#96;n&#96;n1. First contact Capita to try to resolve the issue.&#96;n&#96;n2. If not resolved, you can use the Fund's Internal Dispute Resolution Procedure (IDRP).&#96;n&#96;n3. If still not resolved, you can contact the Pensions Ombudsman - an independent service to resolve pension complaints.&#96;n&#96;nThe Pensions Advisory Service (MoneyHelper) can also provide free, impartial guidance.\"; keywords = \"complaint,IDRP,ombudsman,dispute\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Where can I get financial advice?\"; content = \"Capita does not provide financial advice. For personal financial advice, you should consult an Independent Financial Adviser (IFA).&#96;n&#96;nFinding an adviser: Use directories such as unbiased.co.uk or the MoneyHelper website.&#96;n&#96;nFees: Financial advisers typically charge for their services. Some offer a free initial consultation.&#96;n&#96;nNote: For transfers over £30,000 from Defined Benefit schemes, you must take regulated financial advice by law.\"; keywords = \"financial advice,IFA,adviser,unbiased\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is TUPE?\"; content = \"TUPE (Transfer of Undertakings Protection of Employment) regulations protect employees when a business transfers to a new employer.&#96;n&#96;nPension implications: If you are TUPE transferred, your pension treatment depends on the specific arrangements negotiated.&#96;n&#96;nPossibilities include:&#96;n- Continued membership of UUKPF&#96;n- Becoming a deferred member&#96;n- Transfer to a new employers scheme&#96;n&#96;nYou will receive specific information about your pension rights in a TUPE situation.\"; keywords = \"TUPE,transfer,business sale,outsourcing\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is contracting out?\"; content = \"Between April 1978 and April 2016, employers could contract out of the State Earnings Related Pension Scheme (SERPS) and later the State Second Pension (S2P).&#96;n&#96;nWhat it meant: Instead of building up additional State pension, you built up pension in your employer scheme. Both you and your employer paid lower National Insurance contributions.&#96;n&#96;nUUKPF status: The UUKPF was contracted out until the rules changed in April 2016.&#96;n&#96;nImpact: Your State Pension may be lower due to contracting out, but you have pension from UUKPF instead.\"; keywords = \"contracting out,SERPS,S2P,NI,state pension\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if Unilever becomes insolvent?\"; content = \"The Fund is held in trust, separate from Unilever. This means Fund assets cannot be claimed by Unilever creditors.&#96;n&#96;nPension Protection Fund (PPF): If Unilever were to become insolvent and the Fund could not pay full benefits, the PPF would provide protection.&#96;n&#96;nPPF compensation: The PPF guarantees most (but not all) pension benefits. There are caps on compensation.&#96;n&#96;nNote: The UUKPF is well funded and Unilever is a strong employer, so this scenario is very unlikely.\"; keywords = \"insolvency,PPF,protection,trust\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How are my benefits valued?\"; content = \"For different purposes, your benefits may be valued in different ways:&#96;n&#96;nCash Equivalent Transfer Value (CETV): The capital sum that would be needed to provide your benefits elsewhere. Used for transfers and divorce.&#96;n&#96;nAnnual Benefit Statement: Shows your projected pension at retirement age.&#96;n&#96;nActuarial valuation: The Trustees and actuary regularly assess the Fund value to check if it can pay all promised benefits.&#96;n&#96;nEach method serves a different purpose and may give different figures.\"; keywords = \"CETV,valuation,transfer value,benefits\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Fund actuary?\"; content = \"The Fund actuary is a qualified professional who advises the Trustees on the financial health of the Fund.&#96;n&#96;nKey roles:&#96;n- Conducting regular actuarial valuations&#96;n- Advising on contribution rates&#96;n- Calculating transfer values and individual benefit quotations&#96;n- Advising on investment strategy impacts&#96;n&#96;nThe actuary helps ensure the Fund can meet its promises to pay members pensions now and in the future.\"; keywords = \"actuary,valuation,funding,contributions\" }\n)\n\n$createdCount = 0; $publishedCount = 0\n\nforeach ($article in $batch7) {\n    $body = @{ title = $article.title; content = $article.content; keywords = $article.keywords; description = $article.title; isrootarticle = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n    try {\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$global:baseUrl/knowledgearticles\" -Headers $global:headers -Method Post -Body $body | Out-Null\n        $createdCount++\n        $versions = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$global:baseUrl/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=title eq '$($article.title)' and isrootarticle eq false&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid\" -Headers $global:headers -Method Get\n        if ($versions.value.Count -gt 0) {\n            $uri = \"$global:baseUrl/knowledgearticles($($versions.value[0].knowledgearticleid))\"\n            Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $global:headers -Method Patch -Body (@{ statecode = 3; statuscode = 7 } | ConvertTo-Json)\n            $publishedCount++\n        }\n    } catch {}\n}\nWrite-Host \"Batch 7: Created $createdCount, Published $publishedCount\""
  },
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "b2e0a0e7-0577-40c1-95bf-bc9f99c35ec0",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-141cd912-ee17-4842-b981-3ea9aa715fa8",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Verify all UUKPF articles\n$articles = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$global:baseUrl/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=contains(title,'UUKPF')&amp;&#96;$select=title,statecode,statuscode,isrootarticle&amp;&#96;$orderby=title\" -Headers $global:headers -Method Get\n\nWrite-Host \"Total UUKPF articles: $($articles.value.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Group by status\n$published = $articles.value | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 3 -and $_.statuscode -eq 7 }\n$draft = $articles.value | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 0 }\n$archived = $articles.value | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 5 -or $_.statuscode -eq 12 }\n$rootArticles = $articles.value | Where-Object { $_.isrootarticle -eq $true }\n$nonRootArticles = $articles.value | Where-Object { $_.isrootarticle -eq $false }\n\nWrite-Host \"Published (statecode=3, statuscode=7): $($published.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Draft: $($draft.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Archived: $($archived.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Root Articles (isrootarticle=True): $($rootArticles.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Non-Root Articles (isrootarticle=False): $($nonRootArticles.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Sample titles:\"\n$articles.value | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \" - $($_.title) [state=$($_.statecode), status=$($_.statuscode), root=$($_.isrootarticle)]\" }"
  },
  "language": "pwsh",
  "autoApproveInfo": {
    "value": "Auto approved for this session ([Disable](command:workbench.action.terminal.chat.disableSessionAutoApproval?%255B%252259e4440c-46fc-40d4-9520-f1c98d0f9189%2522%255D))",
    "isTrusted": {
      "enabledCommands": [
        "workbench.action.terminal.chat.disableSessionAutoApproval"
      ]
    },
```

```json
    "original": "# Get fresh token with proper conversion\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$secureToken = $tokenResponse.Token\nif ($secureToken -is [System.Security.SecureString]) {\n    $token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secureToken))\n} else {\n    $token = $secureToken\n}\n\n$h = @{\n    \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"\n    \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\"\n}\n\n$result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$select=title,statecode,statuscode,isrootarticle&amp;&#96;$top=150\" -Headers $h -Method Get\nWrite-Host \"Total knowledge articles: $($result.value.Count)\"\n\n$uukpf = $result.value | Where-Object { $_.title -like \"*UUKPF*\" }\n$published = $uukpf | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 3 -and $_.statuscode -eq 7 }\n$nonRoot = $uukpf | Where-Object { $_.isrootarticle -eq $false }\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"=== FINAL SUMMARY ===\"\nWrite-Host \"UUKPF articles: $($uukpf.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Published (statecode=3, statuscode=7): $($published.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Non-root (Root Article = No): $($nonRoot.Count)\""
```

```json
    "original": "# Check if there's pagination\nWrite-Host \"Retrieved count: $($allArticles.value.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Has nextLink: $($null -ne $allArticles.'@odata.nextLink')\"\n\n# Get all pages\n$allItems = [System.Collections.ArrayList]@()\n$allItems.AddRange($allArticles.value)\n$nextLink = $allArticles.'@odata.nextLink'\n\nwhile ($nextLink) {\n    $nextResult = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $nextLink -Headers $h -Method Get\n    $allItems.AddRange($nextResult.value)\n    $nextLink = $nextResult.'@odata.nextLink'\n    Write-Host \"Fetched more, total now: $($allItems.Count)\"\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Total articles retrieved: $($allItems.Count)\"\n\n# Now filter for UUKPF\n$uukpf = @($allItems | Where-Object { $_.title -like \"*UUKPF*\" })\nWrite-Host \"UUKPF articles: $($uukpf.Count)\"\n\nif ($uukpf.Count -gt 0) {\n    $published = @($uukpf | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 3 -and $_.statuscode -eq 7 })\n    $nonRoot = @($uukpf | Where-Object { $_.isrootarticle -eq $false })\n    Write-Host \"Published: $($published.Count)\"\n    Write-Host \"Non-root: $($nonRoot.Count)\"\n}"
  },
```

```json
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# All 70 FAQ articles - creating in groups\n# Store headers globally\n$global:h = $h\n\n$allArticles = @(\n    # Batch 1 - Membership basics\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Who can join the Fund?\"; content = \"Eligibility to join the UUKPF depends on your employment status and the date you joined Unilever.&#96;n&#96;nFrom 1 October 2021: New employees are eligible to join the Investing Plan (defined contribution section).&#96;n&#96;nBefore 1 October 2021: Employees who joined before this date may have DB (Defined Benefit) section membership.&#96;n&#96;nFor specific eligibility questions, contact Capita or check with your HR department.\"; keywords = \"eligibility,join,membership,new employee\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I become a member?\"; content = \"Eligible employees are automatically enrolled into the UUKPF.&#96;n&#96;nAutomatic enrolment: If you are eligible, you will be automatically enrolled unless you choose to opt out.&#96;n&#96;nOpting in: If you previously opted out, you may be able to rejoin during an election window. Contact Capita for details.&#96;n&#96;nInvesting Plan: New members from 1 October 2021 join the Investing Plan section.\"; keywords = \"automatic enrolment,join,opt in,enrolment\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What are my contribution rates?\"; content = \"Contribution rates vary depending on which section of the Fund you are in and your earnings.&#96;n&#96;nDB Section: Contributions are tiered based on pensionable salary bands. Rates typically range from around 4% to 8%.&#96;n&#96;nInvesting Plan (DC Section): Standard contribution rates apply with employer matching up to certain limits.&#96;n&#96;nYou can find your specific contribution rate on your payslip or by logging into the member portal at uukpf.co.uk\"; keywords = \"contributions,rates,percentage,payslip\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I make additional contributions?\"; content = \"Yes, you can boost your retirement savings by making additional contributions.&#96;n&#96;nDB Section: Additional Voluntary Contributions (AVCs) may be available.&#96;n&#96;nInvesting Plan: You can increase your contribution level above the minimum.&#96;n&#96;nTax relief: Additional contributions generally attract tax relief up to your Annual Allowance.&#96;n&#96;nContact Capita or check the member portal for options available to you.\"; keywords = \"additional contributions,AVC,extra,boost\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Unilever UK Pension Fund?\"; content = \"The Unilever UK Pension Fund (UUKPF) is an occupational pension scheme sponsored by Unilever for eligible UK employees.&#96;n&#96;nThe Fund has two main sections:&#96;n1. Defined Benefit (DB) section - includes Final Salary and CARE benefits&#96;n2. Defined Contribution (DC) section - the Investing Plan&#96;n&#96;nThe Fund is administered by Capita on behalf of the Trustees.&#96;n&#96;nWebsite: uukpf.co.uk\"; keywords = \"UUKPF,overview,sections,DB,DC,Capita\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - When can I access my pension?\"; content = \"Normal Retirement Age: 65 for most members.&#96;n&#96;nEarly retirement: You can take your pension from age 55, but benefits will be reduced for early payment (unless you qualify for no reduction).&#96;n&#96;nLate retirement: You can delay taking your pension beyond 65. Benefits will receive an actuarial increase.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Minimum pension age is increasing to 57 from 6 April 2028 in line with government changes.\"; keywords = \"retirement age,early retirement,55,65,access pension\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What benefits does the Fund provide?\"; content = \"The UUKPF provides retirement and death benefits:&#96;n&#96;nRetirement benefits:&#96;n- Lifetime pension income&#96;n- Option to take tax-free cash lump sum&#96;n- Annual pension increases&#96;n&#96;nDeath benefits:&#96;n- Lump sum payment on death in service (4x salary)&#96;n- Spouse/partner pension&#96;n- Children's pensions&#96;n&#96;nThe exact benefits depend on which section you are in and your service dates.\"; keywords = \"benefits,pension,death benefits,lump sum,spouse pension\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the CARE section?\"; content = \"CARE stands for Career Average Revalued Earnings.&#96;n&#96;nHow it works: Each year, you earn a pension based on your pensionable salary that year. This is added to your pension pot and revalued (increased) each year until retirement.&#96;n&#96;nAccrual rate: Typically 1/75th of pensionable salary per year.&#96;n&#96;nRevaluation: Annual increases in line with CPI (capped at 2.5%).&#96;n&#96;nThis section applied to service from 1 July 2012 to 30 September 2021.\"; keywords = \"CARE,career average,revaluation,1/75th\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Final Salary section?\"; content = \"The Final Salary section provides pension based on your salary at or near retirement.&#96;n&#96;nHow it works: Pension = Final Pensionable Salary x Accrual Rate x Years of Service&#96;n&#96;nAccrual rate: Typically 1/60th per year of service.&#96;n&#96;nFinal Pensionable Salary: Usually the highest of your last 12 months pay, or average of best 3 years in last 10.&#96;n&#96;nThis section closed for future accrual on 30 June 2012 for most members.\"; keywords = \"final salary,1/60th,pensionable salary\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How are my benefits calculated?\"; content = \"Your pension has two parts:&#96;n&#96;n1. Final Salary section (for service up to 30 June 2012):&#96;nPension = (Final Pensionable Salary x Accrual Rate x Years of service)&#96;n&#96;n2. CARE section (for service from 1 July 2012):&#96;nEach year, a pension is calculated based on your pensionable salary that year. These annual amounts are revalued each year until retirement.&#96;n&#96;nInvesting Plan (from 1 October 2021):&#96;nContributions are invested. At retirement, you can take benefits from your investment pot.&#96;n&#96;nTotal pension = Final Salary pension + CARE pension + Investing Plan benefits\"; keywords = \"calculation,final salary,CARE,pension formula\" }\n)\n\n$createdCount = 0\nforeach ($article in $allArticles) {\n    $body = @{ title = $article.title; content = $article.content; keywords = $article.keywords; description = $article.title; isrootarticle = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n    try {\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\" -Headers $h -Method Post -Body $body | Out-Null\n        $createdCount++\n    } catch { Write-Host \"Error creating: $($article.title)\" }\n}\nWrite-Host \"Created $createdCount articles (batch 1 of 7)\""
  },
```

<summary>Tool use: **run_in_terminal**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "409f930d-7e18-4e18-85dc-c7f788ebd21c",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-f6fac446-d588-4101-bc7f-6f77c1732dd3",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Batch 2-7 combined for efficiency\n$batch2to7 = @(\n    # Leaving/Opt-out\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I opt out of the pension scheme?\"; content = \"Yes, you can opt out of the plan at any time. You can download a copy of the opt out form from uukpf.co.uk.&#96;n&#96;nPlease note that once opted out, you will only have one chance to opt back into the DB section of the Fund either in the next or following election window.\"; keywords = \"opt out,leave scheme,election window\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if I leave the pension scheme?\"; content = \"If you have two or more years pensionable service:&#96;nYou will become a deferred member. Your benefits will be calculated at the date you left and effectively frozen until you elect to take them (from age 55). Benefits receive annual increases in deferment.&#96;n&#96;nYour Investing plan account continues to be invested. You cannot make further contributions but can still change fund choices.&#96;n&#96;nIf over age 55, you can retire directly from active service provided you have left relevant employment.&#96;n&#96;nIf you have less than two years pensionable service:&#96;nYou can elect to receive a refund of your contributions plus interest, plus any Investing Plan contributions plus investment growth, less tax.&#96;n&#96;nIf no reply received within 4 months, the default option is an automatic refund of contributions.\"; keywords = \"leave scheme,deferred,refund,contributions,leaving service\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How does my pension increase in deferment?\"; content = \"Benefits accrued before 1 July 2012: In line with January RPI up to a maximum of 5%&#96;n&#96;nBenefits accrued between 1 July 2012 and 30 September 2021: By the lower of the amount of RPI inflation over the whole period or 2.5% for each year for the whole period&#96;n&#96;nBenefits accrued from 1 October 2021: By the lower of the amount of CPI inflation over the whole period or 2.5% for each year for the whole period\"; keywords = \"deferment,increases,RPI,CPI,inflation,deferred pension\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if I work part-time?\"; content = \"If you work part time, your contributions are adjusted to reflect this. They are still based on your pensionable earnings, but the lower and higher levels are reduced in line with the number of hours you actually work compared with full-time hours.\"; keywords = \"part-time,contributions,hours,adjusted\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens to my pension on maternity or paternity leave?\"; content = \"Paid leave: During paid maternity, paternity, adoption or parental leave, you will pay contributions on the pay you receive and your pension will continue building up as normal.&#96;n&#96;nUnpaid leave: During unpaid leave, your contributions will stop and you will normally stop building up pension benefits. On your return to work, you have a one-off choice to buyback your missing pension.&#96;n&#96;nIf you elect to buyback, you can pay monthly over a maximum 6 month period or as a one-off payment from salary.\"; keywords = \"maternity,paternity,adoption,parental leave,buyback\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens to my pension if I am absent due to illness?\"; content = \"Paid sick leave: During paid sick leave, your pension will build up based on the pay you actually receive during the period of absence.&#96;n&#96;nUnpaid sick leave: During unpaid sick leave, your contributions will stop and you will stop building up pension. There is no facility to make up contributions when you return to work.\"; keywords = \"sick leave,illness,absence,contributions\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What if my service record is incorrect?\"; content = \"The Pension Fund is advised of your Company and Pensionable start date by the Company.&#96;n&#96;nIf you joined a Unilever Company before 1988, you were unable to join the Fund until age 21. This reduced to age 18 from 6 April 1988.&#96;n&#96;nIf you believe your service dates are incorrect, please contact Capita for investigation.\"; keywords = \"service record,dates,incorrect,start date\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - International Assignees localising in the UK\"; content = \"Employees may come to the UK on an international assignment, joining the UK payroll and paying NI Contributions but staying in their home country pension fund.&#96;n&#96;nSome IAs do not return to their home country and are localised. IAs who localise after 30 September 2021 should be enrolled into the RSP and queries forwarded to Fidelity.\"; keywords = \"international assignee,IA,localise,UK,RSP,Fidelity\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens to my pension if I transfer overseas?\"; content = \"If going on an International Assignment and expected to return to the UK: Contact the Expert Admin Team (EAT) who can confirm pension arrangements. Email: expertadminteam@unilever.com&#96;n&#96;nIf moving on a permanent transfer: You will be treated in the same way as a voluntary leaver.\"; keywords = \"overseas,international assignment,transfer,EAT\" },\n    # Death benefits\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Spouse/civil partner pension on death\"; content = \"A pension will be payable to a legally married spouse or civil partner on your death.&#96;n&#96;nIf in service: Half the pension you have built up to death, plus if you die before age 65, half the pension you could have built up from death to age 65.&#96;n&#96;nIf deferred: Half your deferred pension, including increases up to date of death.&#96;n&#96;nIf retired: Half the pension you were receiving at death.&#96;n&#96;nThe pension will be adjusted if your spouse/civil partner is more than 10 years older or younger than you.\"; keywords = \"spouse,civil partner,death,pension,survivor\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Children's pensions on death\"; content = \"A pension will be paid to any eligible child under age 18 (or 23 if in full-time education) if you die in pensionable service, deferred or retired membership.&#96;n&#96;nAmount: Total children pension equals Spouse pension. If only one child, only half is paid. If 2+ children, they share the equivalent of the spouse pension.&#96;n&#96;nDuration: Paid until age 18 or 23 if in full-time education.\"; keywords = \"children,death,pension,education,dependent\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Lump sum on death in service\"; content = \"A lump sum of four times Basic Pay is payable if you die in pensionable service (or four times Pensionable Pay if greater).&#96;n&#96;nThe lump sum is not automatically paid to a specific person. The Trustees decide who should receive it, considering members nominations and other circumstances.\"; keywords = \"death in service,lump sum,four times salary\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Who is eligible to receive the death in service lump sum?\"; content = \"Benefits may be paid to your spouse, civil partner, children, cohabitee, family member, friend, colleague, estate, or even a charity.&#96;n&#96;nWhen benefits become payable, the Trustees consider all circumstances and exercise their discretion. A nomination is important and should be kept up to date.\"; keywords = \"death in service,nomination,beneficiary,lump sum\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Lump sum on death in deferment\"; content = \"If you die after leaving Unilever and before you retire, a death benefit equal to five times your deferred annual pension is payable, subject to a minimum of 50% of the amount of your contributions.&#96;n&#96;nThe lump sum is discretionary and will be paid considering your nominations.\"; keywords = \"death in deferment,lump sum,deferred member\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if my spouse/partner dies before me?\"; content = \"If your spouse dies before you there would be no pension payable to them. However any children's pensions will still be payable on your death, and a pension may be payable to a surviving cohabitee if you are still living with them at the date of your death.\"; keywords = \"spouse death,predeceased,cohabitee\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I make a nomination?\"; content = \"You can express a wish about who should receive your discretionary lump sum death benefits via the member secure portal on uukpf.co.uk&#96;n&#96;nNavigate to 'Death benefit nomination' from the home page to input your nomination online.&#96;n&#96;nNominations should be reviewed regularly and updated following any changes in personal circumstances.\"; keywords = \"nomination,death benefit,secure portal\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is a cohabitee?\"; content = \"A cohabitee is a person who has been living with a member as their partner for at least 12 months immediately preceding their death (the member not being legally married or in a civil partnership).&#96;n&#96;nOn death in pensionable service: The cohabitee receives a spouse-level pension at Trustees discretion.&#96;n&#96;nOn death after leaving service: A pension will only be paid if the member has nominated their cohabitee and they can prove financial dependency.\"; keywords = \"cohabitee,common law,partner,unmarried spouse\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is GMP (Guaranteed Minimum Pension)?\"; content = \"Between April 1978 and April 1997, contracting-out of SERPS was on the basis that the occupational pension scheme guaranteed a minimum level of pension. The minimum amount is called the GMP.&#96;n&#96;nGMP is broadly equal to the SERPS benefit you would have received had your employer not been contracted-out.&#96;n&#96;nGMP is not an additional payment. It forms part of your overall pension.\"; keywords = \"GMP,guaranteed minimum pension,SERPS,contracting out\" },\n    # Retirement\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What retirement options are available?\"; content = \"Normal Retirement Age: 65&#96;n&#96;nEarly retirement: From age 55. Benefits are reduced for early payment unless you qualify for no reduction.&#96;n&#96;nLate retirement: Up to age 75. Benefits receive actuarial increase.&#96;n&#96;nFlexible/Partial retirement: Some employers support this - check with your HR department.&#96;n&#96;nCash commutation: Up to 25% of pension as tax-free cash.\"; keywords = \"retirement,early,late,flexible,options,age 55,age 65\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What if I want to retire early?\"; content = \"Early retirement: From age 55, you may take your pension early. Benefits are reduced to reflect the longer expected payment period.&#96;n&#96;nReduction factors: Approximately 4-5% per year before normal retirement age (65).&#96;n&#96;nNo reduction may apply if: Retiring due to redundancy, company sale/outsourcing, or ill health.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Your employer must agree to early retirement if you are still in service.\"; keywords = \"early retirement,reduction,age 55\" }\n)\n\n$createdCount = 0\nforeach ($article in $batch2to7) {\n    $body = @{ title = $article.title; content = $article.content; keywords = $article.keywords; description = $article.title; isrootarticle = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n    try {\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\" -Headers $h -Method Post -Body $body | Out-Null\n        $createdCount++\n    } catch { Write-Host \"Error: $($article.title.Substring(0,30))\" }\n}\nWrite-Host \"Created $createdCount articles (batch 2)\""
  },
  "language": "pwsh",
```

Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "5d71b920-988c-48d7-b293-ca1d32d8fd05",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-6c5dc052-df7c-4998-bcbe-3e810ddf1af2",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Batch 3 - More topics\n$batch3 = @(\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I retire on ill health grounds?\"; content = \"If you are too ill to continue working, you may be able to retire early on medical grounds.&#96;n&#96;nIll health pensions may be paid without reduction if you are unlikely to work again due to illness.&#96;n&#96;nThe process: You must provide medical evidence. The Trustees Medical Adviser will review and the Trustees make the final decision.\"; keywords = \"ill health,medical,early retirement,disability\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is my Final Pensionable Salary?\"; content = \"Final Pensionable Salary is the highest of: Basic Pay in the 12 months before leaving/retiring, Average of any 3 consecutive years Basic Pay in the last 10 years (revalued), or Total Basic Pay in the last 3 years divided by 3.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Overtime, bonuses and other irregular payments are generally not included.\"; keywords = \"final pensionable salary,FPS,basic pay,calculation\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the accrual rate?\"; content = \"The accrual rate determines how quickly you build up pension.&#96;n&#96;nFinal Salary section (pre-July 2012): 1/60th of Final Pensionable Salary for each year of pensionable service.&#96;n&#96;nCARE section (July 2012 to September 2021): 1/75th of Pensionable Salary each year, revalued annually.\"; keywords = \"accrual rate,1/60th,1/75th,pension build up\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I take a tax-free lump sum?\"; content = \"Yes, you can exchange part of your pension for a tax-free cash lump sum at retirement.&#96;n&#96;nMaximum: Generally 25% of your total pension value.&#96;n&#96;nExchange rate: Typically around 12-15 pounds of cash for each 1 pound of annual pension given up.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Taking cash will permanently reduce your annual pension. This is also known as commutation.\"; keywords = \"tax-free,lump sum,commutation,cash,25%\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What tax will I pay on my pension?\"; content = \"Your pension is treated as earned income for tax purposes.&#96;n&#96;nPAYE: Tax is deducted at source before payment under PAYE.&#96;n&#96;nTax Code: HMRC issues a tax code. If you have other income, your tax code may be adjusted.&#96;n&#96;nState Pension: When State Pension starts, your tax code will change as State Pension is also taxable.&#96;n&#96;nNote: The tax-free cash lump sum at retirement is not taxable.\"; keywords = \"tax,PAYE,tax code,income tax\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Annual Allowance?\"; content = \"The Annual Allowance is the maximum amount of pension savings you can make each year with tax relief.&#96;n&#96;nCurrent limit: 60,000 pounds (2023/24) but may be lower if you have tapered annual allowance or high income.&#96;n&#96;nExceeding the allowance: You may have to pay an Annual Allowance charge. The Fund can pay this charge on your behalf (scheme pays) and reduce your pension accordingly.\"; keywords = \"annual allowance,tax relief,scheme pays,pension savings\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Lifetime Allowance?\"; content = \"The Lifetime Allowance (LTA) was the limit on total pension savings you could build up without additional tax charges.&#96;n&#96;nNote: The LTA tax charge was abolished from 6 April 2023. However, protections (Fixed Protection, Individual Protection) may still affect your benefits.\"; keywords = \"lifetime allowance,LTA,tax,protection\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How does divorce affect my pension?\"; content = \"On divorce, your pension is an asset that may be considered.&#96;n&#96;nPension Sharing Order: The court may order that a portion of your pension is transferred to your ex-spouse. They would receive their own pension from the Fund.&#96;n&#96;nPension Attachment Order: Part of your pension may be paid to your ex-spouse when your benefits come into payment.&#96;n&#96;nNote: If you divorce, the Fund needs a copy of the court order. Legal charges may apply.\"; keywords = \"divorce,pension sharing,attachment,court order\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What information does the Fund provide on divorce?\"; content = \"For divorce proceedings, the Fund can provide a Cash Equivalent Transfer Value (CETV) which is the current capital value of your pension rights.&#96;n&#96;nThis is used by solicitors/courts to determine how assets should be divided.&#96;n&#96;nYou or your solicitor should contact Capita to request divorce information. There may be a fee for this service.\"; keywords = \"divorce,CETV,transfer value,solicitor\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if I am made redundant?\"; content = \"If you are made redundant at age 55 or over, you may be able to take your pension immediately without reduction (subject to company and Trustee consent).&#96;n&#96;nUnder age 55: You will become a deferred member.&#96;n&#96;nCARE element: If you leave due to redundancy, the CARE element of your pension may continue to receive annual increases as if you were still in pensionable service.\"; keywords = \"redundancy,made redundant,early retirement,no reduction\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I transfer my pension?\"; content = \"Yes, you can transfer your UUKPF benefits to another registered pension scheme.&#96;n&#96;nProcess: Request a transfer value quotation from Capita. The quote is valid for 3 months.&#96;n&#96;nConsiderations: Transfers from Defined Benefit schemes often require financial advice. If your transfer value exceeds 30,000 pounds, you must take regulated financial advice before transferring.\"; keywords = \"transfer,CETV,transfer value,other scheme\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I transfer a pension from another scheme into UUKPF?\"; content = \"Transfer In is no longer permitted to the UUKPF Defined Benefit section.&#96;n&#96;nHowever, you may be able to transfer benefits from other schemes into the Investing Plan (DC section). Contact Fidelity for more information about transfers to the Investing Plan.\"; keywords = \"transfer in,other scheme,DC,investing plan\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I contact Capita?\"; content = \"By telephone: 0345 602 9498 - Lines are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (excluding bank holidays).&#96;n&#96;nBy email: Via the secure messaging service on uukpf.co.uk&#96;n&#96;nBy post: UUKPF, Capita, PO Box 555, Stead House, Darlington, DL1 9YT&#96;n&#96;nSecure portal: Log in at uukpf.co.uk to view your benefits, update personal details, make nominations, and send secure messages.\"; keywords = \"contact,telephone,email,Capita,address\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the member portal?\"; content = \"The member secure portal at uukpf.co.uk allows you to: View your current and projected pension benefits, Update your personal details and contact information, Make or change your death benefit nominations, Send secure messages to Capita, Download forms and documents, View your annual benefit statement.&#96;n&#96;nTo register, you need your National Insurance number and date of birth.\"; keywords = \"portal,website,online,uukpf.co.uk,secure\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I update my personal details?\"; content = \"You can update your personal details via the member secure portal at uukpf.co.uk&#96;n&#96;nThis includes: Address changes, Email address, Telephone number, Marital status (you should also advise of marriage, civil partnership, or divorce), Name changes (supporting documentation may be required).&#96;n&#96;nIf you cannot access the portal, contact Capita directly.\"; keywords = \"update,personal details,address,email,telephone\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - When will I receive my annual benefit statement?\"; content = \"Annual Benefit Statements are issued each year, typically within the first half of the year for the previous year end.&#96;n&#96;nActive members: Statement shows benefits accrued and projected pension at normal retirement age.&#96;n&#96;nDeferred members: Statement shows your preserved benefits and projected pension.&#96;n&#96;nPensioners: A P60 is issued showing pension paid and tax deducted in the tax year.&#96;n&#96;nStatements are available online via the member portal.\"; keywords = \"annual statement,benefit statement,P60\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is State Pension?\"; content = \"State Pension is a government pension payable from State Pension age.&#96;n&#96;nCurrent State Pension age: 66, increasing to 67 between 2026 and 2028.&#96;n&#96;nYour UUKPF pension is separate from and in addition to any State Pension.&#96;n&#96;nTo check your State Pension entitlement and forecast, visit gov.uk/check-state-pension&#96;n&#96;nNote: The UUKPF was contracted-out of the State scheme between 1978 and 1997.\"; keywords = \"state pension,government,pension age,NI\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is a Pension Scam?\"; content = \"Pension scams are attempts by fraudsters to steal your pension savings.&#96;n&#96;nWarning signs: Contact out of the blue offering a free pension review, Promises of guaranteed high returns, Pressure to act quickly, Offers of early access to pension before age 55, Request to transfer to an overseas scheme.&#96;n&#96;nNEVER give personal or financial details to cold callers.&#96;n&#96;nIf you suspect a scam, report to Action Fraud on 0300 123 2040.\"; keywords = \"scam,fraud,warning,cold call,transfer\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Who are the Trustees?\"; content = \"The UUKPF is managed by a Board of Trustees who are responsible for: Looking after the Fund and its assets, Paying benefits correctly and on time, Communicating with members, Investing the Fund assets.&#96;n&#96;nThe Trustees are supported by professional advisors including actuaries, investment managers, and lawyers.&#96;n&#96;nTrustee decisions are made in the best interest of all members and beneficiaries.\"; keywords = \"trustees,governance,management,responsibility\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I request a pension estimate?\"; content = \"You can obtain a pension estimate in several ways:&#96;n&#96;n1. Online: Log in to the member portal at uukpf.co.uk and use the projection tools.&#96;n&#96;n2. Written request: Contact Capita to request an estimate for a specific retirement date.&#96;n&#96;nNote: Estimates are for guidance only and based on current information. Actual benefits may differ.\"; keywords = \"estimate,projection,quote,retirement\" }\n)\n\n$createdCount = 0\nforeach ($article in $batch3) {\n    $body = @{ title = $article.title; content = $article.content; keywords = $article.keywords; description = $article.title; isrootarticle = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n    try {\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\" -Headers $h -Method Post -Body $body | Out-Null\n        $createdCount++\n    } catch {}\n}\nWrite-Host \"Created $createdCount articles (batch 3)\""
  },
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "cb807b77-ca50-4f2e-adb4-947a1279561c",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-30ce0e09-f592-4f0a-95a9-cf03942037ba",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Batch 4 - Final articles\n$batch4 = @(\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do I start my retirement?\"; content = \"To start drawing your pension:&#96;n&#96;n1. Contact Capita at least 3 months before your intended retirement date.&#96;n2. Capita will send retirement options documentation including an option form.&#96;n3. Choose your options (e.g., how much tax-free cash to take).&#96;n4. Return the completed form with any required documents.&#96;n5. Capita will calculate your final benefits and set up payment.\"; keywords = \"start pension,retire,claim,options form\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What documents do I need to retire?\"; content = \"When claiming your pension, you may need to provide: Birth certificate or passport (proof of age), Marriage or civil partnership certificate (if applicable), Decree absolute (if divorced), Bank details for pension payment, P45 from your employer (if retiring directly from service).&#96;n&#96;nCapita will advise which specific documents are required.\"; keywords = \"documents,birth certificate,marriage certificate,P45,proof\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - When will my pension be paid?\"; content = \"Pensions are paid monthly in arrears, on the last working day of each month.&#96;n&#96;nPayment method: Direct credit to your UK bank or building society account. Overseas payments may also be possible but may incur charges.&#96;n&#96;nP60: You will receive an annual P60 showing your total pension and tax deducted for the tax year.\"; keywords = \"payment,monthly,bank,arrears\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How do my pension increases work in retirement?\"; content = \"Your pension is reviewed annually on 1 April.&#96;n&#96;nBenefits built up before 1 July 2012: Increase by January RPI, capped at 5%.&#96;n&#96;nBenefits built up from 1 July 2012 to 30 September 2021: Increase by the lower of RPI and 2.5%.&#96;n&#96;nBenefits built up from 1 October 2021: Increase by the lower of CPI and 2.5%.\"; keywords = \"increases,RPI,CPI,inflation,annual increase,pensioner\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is pension bridging?\"; content = \"Pension bridging is an option that may be available if you retire before State Pension age.&#96;n&#96;nHow it works: You receive a higher pension from your Fund retirement date until State Pension age. Once your State Pension starts, your Fund pension reduces.&#96;n&#96;nPurpose: To provide a more level total income before and after State Pension age.\"; keywords = \"bridging,state pension age,level income\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is Added Years?\"; content = \"Added Years was a historic method of purchasing additional pension.&#96;n&#96;nHow it worked: By paying extra contributions, members could buy additional years of pensionable service, increasing their final pension.&#96;n&#96;nClosed to new purchases: This option is no longer available for new purchases, but members who previously bought Added Years retain that benefit.\"; keywords = \"added years,AVC,additional,purchase\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What are AVCs?\"; content = \"AVCs (Additional Voluntary Contributions) allow you to save extra for retirement on top of your main pension.&#96;n&#96;nHistoric UUKPF AVCs: If you made AVCs before a certain date, these may provide additional benefits within the Fund.&#96;n&#96;nCurrent additional savings: New additional savings are directed to the Investing Plan (DC section) managed by Fidelity.\"; keywords = \"AVC,additional voluntary,extra,Fidelity,investing plan\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Investing Plan?\"; content = \"The Investing Plan is the Defined Contribution (DC) section of UUKPF.&#96;n&#96;nFrom 1 October 2021, new members join the Investing Plan rather than the Defined Benefit section.&#96;n&#96;nHow it works: Contributions are invested in funds you choose. At retirement, you can take a tax-free lump sum and use the remainder to provide income.&#96;n&#96;nAdministration: The Investing Plan is administered by Fidelity.\"; keywords = \"investing plan,DC,defined contribution,Fidelity\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the difference between DB and DC?\"; content = \"Defined Benefit (DB): Final Salary and CARE sections. Pension based on salary and years of service. Guaranteed lifetime income from retirement. Investment risk borne by the Fund.&#96;n&#96;nDefined Contribution (DC): Investing Plan section. Pension pot based on contributions plus investment growth. Benefits depend on fund performance. Investment risk borne by the member.\"; keywords = \"DB,DC,defined benefit,defined contribution,difference\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is flexible retirement?\"; content = \"Flexible or partial retirement allows you to reduce your working hours and start drawing some pension while continuing to work part-time.&#96;n&#96;nAvailability: Subject to employer agreement. Check with your HR department if this is available in your role.\"; keywords = \"flexible retirement,partial retirement,part-time,phased\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Can I retire and be re-employed?\"; content = \"Yes, it is possible to retire, start drawing your pension, and then be re-employed.&#96;n&#96;nConsiderations: You cannot rejoin the UUKPF DB section after retirement. If re-employed, you may be enrolled in the Investing Plan. There may be tax implications, particularly around Annual Allowance.\"; keywords = \"re-employment,retire,continue working\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is a small pot lump sum?\"; content = \"If your total pension is very small, you may be able to take it as a one-off lump sum instead of a regular pension.&#96;n&#96;nTrivial commutation: If your total benefits from all sources are below a de minimis limit (currently around 30,000 pounds), you may be able to commute your entire pension to a lump sum.&#96;n&#96;nTax: 25% is tax-free, 75% is taxable.\"; keywords = \"small pot,trivial commutation,lump sum,de minimis\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What if I have a complaint?\"; content = \"If you are unhappy with any aspect of your pension, you should:&#96;n&#96;n1. First contact Capita to try to resolve the issue.&#96;n2. If not resolved, you can use the Fund's Internal Dispute Resolution Procedure (IDRP).&#96;n3. If still not resolved, you can contact the Pensions Ombudsman.&#96;n&#96;nThe Pensions Advisory Service (MoneyHelper) can also provide free, impartial guidance.\"; keywords = \"complaint,IDRP,ombudsman,dispute\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Where can I get financial advice?\"; content = \"Capita does not provide financial advice. For personal financial advice, you should consult an Independent Financial Adviser (IFA).&#96;n&#96;nFinding an adviser: Use directories such as unbiased.co.uk or the MoneyHelper website.&#96;n&#96;nNote: For transfers over 30,000 pounds from Defined Benefit schemes, you must take regulated financial advice by law.\"; keywords = \"financial advice,IFA,adviser,unbiased\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is TUPE?\"; content = \"TUPE (Transfer of Undertakings Protection of Employment) regulations protect employees when a business transfers to a new employer.&#96;n&#96;nPension implications: If you are TUPE transferred, your pension treatment depends on the specific arrangements negotiated. You will receive specific information about your pension rights in a TUPE situation.\"; keywords = \"TUPE,transfer,business sale,outsourcing\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is contracting out?\"; content = \"Between April 1978 and April 2016, employers could contract out of the State Earnings Related Pension Scheme (SERPS) and later the State Second Pension (S2P).&#96;n&#96;nWhat it meant: Instead of building up additional State pension, you built up pension in your employer scheme. Both you and your employer paid lower National Insurance contributions.&#96;n&#96;nUUKPF status: The UUKPF was contracted out until the rules changed in April 2016.\"; keywords = \"contracting out,SERPS,S2P,NI,state pension\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What happens if Unilever becomes insolvent?\"; content = \"The Fund is held in trust, separate from Unilever. This means Fund assets cannot be claimed by Unilever creditors.&#96;n&#96;nPension Protection Fund (PPF): If Unilever were to become insolvent and the Fund could not pay full benefits, the PPF would provide protection.&#96;n&#96;nNote: The UUKPF is well funded and Unilever is a strong employer, so this scenario is very unlikely.\"; keywords = \"insolvency,PPF,protection,trust\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - How are my benefits valued?\"; content = \"For different purposes, your benefits may be valued in different ways:&#96;n&#96;nCash Equivalent Transfer Value (CETV): The capital sum that would be needed to provide your benefits elsewhere. Used for transfers and divorce.&#96;n&#96;nAnnual Benefit Statement: Shows your projected pension at retirement age.&#96;n&#96;nActuarial valuation: The Trustees and actuary regularly assess the Fund value.\"; keywords = \"CETV,valuation,transfer value,benefits\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - What is the Fund actuary?\"; content = \"The Fund actuary is a qualified professional who advises the Trustees on the financial health of the Fund.&#96;n&#96;nKey roles: Conducting regular actuarial valuations, Advising on contribution rates, Calculating transfer values and individual benefit quotations, Advising on investment strategy impacts.\"; keywords = \"actuary,valuation,funding,contributions\" },\n    @{ title = \"UUKPF - Summary of key contacts\"; content = \"UUKPF Administration (Capita): 0345 602 9498, uukpf.co.uk&#96;n&#96;nInvesting Plan (Fidelity): fidelitypensions.com&#96;n&#96;nExpert Admin Team (International): expertadminteam@unilever.com&#96;n&#96;nState Pension information: gov.uk/check-state-pension&#96;n&#96;nPensions Ombudsman: pensions-ombudsman.org.uk&#96;n&#96;nMoneyHelper: moneyhelper.org.uk\"; keywords = \"contacts,phone,email,Capita,Fidelity,help\" }\n)\n\n$createdCount = 0\nforeach ($article in $batch4) {\n    $body = @{ title = $article.title; content = $article.content; keywords = $article.keywords; description = $article.title; isrootarticle = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n    try {\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\" -Headers $h -Method Post -Body $body | Out-Null\n        $createdCount++\n    } catch {}\n}\nWrite-Host \"Created $createdCount articles (batch 4 - final)\""
  },
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="run_in_terminal">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **run_in_terminal**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "6e083802-5837-4278-9755-999ee62ecdc8",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-98008d51-6310-46f1-b2d6-65a694d16b6a",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Complete script - refresh token, create articles, publish them\n# Step 1: Fresh token\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$secureToken = $tokenResponse.Token\nif ($secureToken -is [System.Security.SecureString]) {\n    $token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secureToken))\n} else {\n    $token = $secureToken\n}\n$h = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\" }\n\n# Step 2: Query existing UUKPF articles\n$existing = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF')&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title,statecode,statuscode,isrootarticle&amp;&#96;$top=200\" -Headers $h\nWrite-Host \"Existing UUKPF articles: $($existing.value.Count)\"\n\n$nonRoot = @($existing.value | Where-Object { $_.isrootarticle -eq $false })\n$published = @($nonRoot | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 3 -and $_.statuscode -eq 7 })\nWrite-Host \"Non-root: $($nonRoot.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Already published: $($published.Count)\"\n\n# Step 3: Publish the non-root ones that aren't published\n$toPublish = @($nonRoot | Where-Object { $_.statecode -ne 3 -or $_.statuscode -ne 7 })\nWrite-Host \"Need to publish: $($toPublish.Count)\"\n\n$pubCount = 0\nforeach ($article in $toPublish) {\n    try {\n        $uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles($($article.knowledgearticleid))\"\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $h -Method Patch -Body '{\"statecode\":3,\"statuscode\":7}'\n        $pubCount++\n    } catch {\n        Write-Host \"Failed to publish: $($article.title.Substring(0,40))...\"\n    }\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Successfully published: $pubCount\""
  },
```

```json
    "original": "# Check content of UUKPF articles\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$secureToken = $tokenResponse.Token\nif ($secureToken -is [System.Security.SecureString]) {\n    $token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secureToken))\n} else {\n    $token = $secureToken\n}\n$h = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\" }\n\n# Get all published non-root UUKPF articles with content\n$articles = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and isrootarticle eq false&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title,content&amp;&#96;$top=100\" -Headers $h\n\nWrite-Host \"Retrieved $($articles.value.Count) articles\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Check which have empty or null content\n$emptyContent = @($articles.value | Where-Object { [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.content) })\nWrite-Host \"Articles with empty/null content: $($emptyContent.Count)\"\n\nif ($emptyContent.Count -gt 0) {\n    Write-Host \"\"\n    Write-Host \"Articles missing content:\"\n    $emptyContent | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"  - $($_.title)\" }\n}"
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "8b7c28bd-fd54-4bf5-844c-a789d827e1d9",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-341d73fe-26f8-4d26-ac4d-0afab2120289",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Final check on all articles\n$finalCheck = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and isrootarticle eq false&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title,content&amp;&#96;$orderby=title\" -Headers $h\n\nWrite-Host \"=== FINAL CONTENT CHECK ===\"\nWrite-Host \"Total articles: $($finalCheck.value.Count)\"\n\n# Check for empty or HTML-only content\n$issues = @()\nforeach ($a in $finalCheck.value) {\n    $stripped = $a.content -replace '&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '' -replace '\\s+', ' '\n    if ($stripped.Trim().Length -lt 50) {\n        $issues += @{ title = $a.title; length = $stripped.Trim().Length; id = $a.knowledgearticleid }\n    }\n}\n\nif ($issues.Count -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"All articles have meaningful content!\"\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"Articles with potential issues: $($issues.Count)\"\n    $issues | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"  $($_.title) - $($_.length) chars\" }\n}\n\n# Show shortest 5 for verification\n$sorted = $finalCheck.value | Sort-Object { ($_.content -replace '&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '').Length }\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Shortest 5 articles (by text length):\"\n$sorted | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object {\n    $textLen = ($_.content -replace '&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '').Length\n    Write-Host \"  $textLen chars - $($_.title)\"\n}"
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "a0dd3e4d-e094-4daa-9364-6741a0cd8007",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-4ee7d49b-b8de-47ef-9ce4-0f8fe252b2a8",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Update ALL articles to have proper HTML formatting\nWrite-Host \"Updating all articles with HTML formatting...\"\n\n$updatedCount = 0\n$errorCount = 0\n\nforeach ($a in $allArticles.value) {\n    # Check if already has HTML tags\n    if ($a.content -notmatch '&lt;[a-zA-Z]') {\n        # Convert plain text to HTML\n        $htmlContent = $a.content -replace \"&#96;r&#96;n&#96;r&#96;n\", \"&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;n&#96;n\", \"&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;r&#96;n\", \"&lt;br/&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;n\", \"&lt;br/&gt;\"\n        $htmlContent = \"&lt;div&gt;&lt;p&gt;$htmlContent&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\"\n        \n        $body = @{ content = $htmlContent } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n        $uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles($($a.knowledgearticleid))\"\n        \n        try {\n            Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $h -Method Patch -Body $body\n            $updatedCount++\n            Write-Host \"Updated: $($a.title)\"\n        } catch {\n            $errorCount++\n            Write-Host \"ERROR updating: $($a.title)\"\n        }\n    } else {\n        Write-Host \"Already HTML: $($a.title)\"\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"=============================\"\nWrite-Host \"Updated: $updatedCount articles\"\nWrite-Host \"Errors: $errorCount\"\nWrite-Host \"Already HTML: $($allArticles.value.Count - $updatedCount - $errorCount)\""
  },
```

Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "91fd4ae1-e819-423f-b106-b86059761e7d",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-7c96cef3-b446-460f-957c-9a8336ae2d2c",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Refresh token\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\"; \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"; \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\" }\n\n# Check ALL 70 articles to verify HTML formatting\n$uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF')&amp;&#96;$select=title,content,statecode,statuscode&amp;&#96;$orderby=title\"\n$allArticles = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\n\nWrite-Host \"Total UUKPF articles: $($allArticles.value.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n$withHtml = 0\n$withoutHtml = 0\n$emptyContent = 0\n$problemArticles = @()\n\nforeach ($a in $allArticles.value) {\n    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.content)) {\n        $emptyContent++\n        $problemArticles += @{ title = $a.title; issue = \"EMPTY\" }\n    } elseif ($a.content.StartsWith(\"&lt;div&gt;\") -or $a.content.StartsWith(\"&lt;p&gt;\")) {\n        $withHtml++\n    } else {\n        $withoutHtml++\n        $problemArticles += @{ title = $a.title; issue = \"NOT HTML\"; preview = $a.content.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(100, $a.content.Length)) }\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Content Status Summary ===\"\nWrite-Host \"With HTML formatting: $withHtml\"\nWrite-Host \"Without HTML (plain text): $withoutHtml\"\nWrite-Host \"Empty content: $emptyContent\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nif ($problemArticles.Count -gt 0) {\n    Write-Host \"=== Problem Articles ===\"\n    foreach ($p in $problemArticles) {\n        Write-Host \"[$($p.issue)] $($p.title)\"\n        if ($p.preview) { Write-Host \"  Preview: $($p.preview)...\" }\n    }\n}"
  },
```

Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "6635ca33-eac1-4cf8-91f0-297c5f19b52c",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-4422b5a7-0e40-4ebf-94a5-9ee4ad4d548f",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Check for duplicates\n$uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF')&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title,statecode,statuscode,isrootarticle&amp;&#96;$orderby=title\"\n$allArticles = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\n\nWrite-Host \"Total UUKPF articles: $($allArticles.value.Count)\"\n\n# Group by title\n$grouped = $allArticles.value | Group-Object -Property title\n\n$uniqueTitles = $grouped.Count\n$duplicates = $grouped | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 }\n\nWrite-Host \"Unique titles: $uniqueTitles\"\nWrite-Host \"Titles with duplicates: $($duplicates.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Show state breakdown\n$published = $allArticles.value | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 3 }\n$draft = $allArticles.value | Where-Object { $_.statecode -eq 0 }\n\nWrite-Host \"Published (statecode=3): $($published.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"Draft (statecode=0): $($draft.Count)\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Show first few duplicates\nif ($duplicates.Count -gt 0) {\n    Write-Host \"=== Sample Duplicates ===\"\n    foreach ($d in $duplicates | Select-Object -First 3) {\n        Write-Host \"Title: $($d.Name)\"\n        foreach ($item in $d.Group) {\n            Write-Host \"  ID: $($item.knowledgearticleid) | State: $($item.statecode) | Status: $($item.statuscode) | IsRoot: $($item.isrootarticle)\"\n        }\n    }\n}"
  },
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "84741a1f-ddac-4b0c-8926-3c690bd6c238",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-1cb19452-f02f-4690-ba10-704e49186225",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Create knowledge articles with HTML content\n# Refresh token\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\"; \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"; \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\"; \"Prefer\" = \"return=representation\" }\n\n$created = 0\n$errors = @()\n\nWrite-Host \"Creating $($qaList.Count) knowledge articles...\"\n\nforeach ($qa in $qaList) {\n    $title = \"UUKPF - $($qa.Q -replace '\\?$', '')\"\n    if ($title.Length -gt 155) { $title = $title.Substring(0, 155) }\n    \n    # Convert content to HTML\n    $htmlContent = $qa.A -replace \"&#96;r&#96;n&#96;r&#96;n\", \"&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;r&#96;n\", \"&lt;br/&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;n&#96;n\", \"&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;\" -replace \"&#96;n\", \"&lt;br/&gt;\"\n    $htmlContent = \"&lt;div&gt;&lt;p&gt;$htmlContent&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\"\n    \n    $article = @{\n        title = $title\n        content = $htmlContent\n        keywords = \"UUKPF, pension, Unilever\"\n        isrootarticle = $false\n    }\n    \n    try {\n        $uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\"\n        $body = $article | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n        $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Post -Body $body\n        $created++\n        if ($created % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host \"Created $created articles...\" }\n    } catch {\n        $errors += @{ title = $title; error = $_.Exception.Message }\n        Write-Host \"Error creating: $title - $($_.Exception.Message)\"\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"=== Creation Summary ===\"\nWrite-Host \"Created: $created\"\nWrite-Host \"Errors: $($errors.Count)\""
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",

  "terminalCommandId": "tool-cdbc9526-2edb-48d0-b2d0-5bd5b7f07940",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Publish all UUKPF articles\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json\"; \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"; \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\" }\n\n# Get all draft UUKPF articles\n$uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and statecode eq 0&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title\"\n$drafts = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\n\nWrite-Host \"Draft articles to publish: $($drafts.value.Count)\"\n\n$published = 0\n$errors = @()\n\nforeach ($article in $drafts.value) {\n    try {\n        $patchUri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles($($article.knowledgearticleid))\"\n        $body = @{ statecode = 3; statuscode = 7 } | ConvertTo-Json\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $patchUri -Headers $headers -Method Patch -Body $body\n        $published++\n        if ($published % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host \"Published $published...\" }\n    } catch {\n        $errors += @{ title = $article.title; error = $_.Exception.Message }\n        Write-Host \"Error publishing $($article.title): $($_.Exception.Message)\"\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"=== Publish Summary ===\"\nWrite-Host \"Published: $published\"\nWrite-Host \"Errors: $($errors.Count)\""
  },
  "language": "pwsh",
  "autoApproveInfo": {
    "value": "Auto approved for this session ([Disable](command:workbench.action.terminal.chat.disableSessionAutoApproval?%255B%252259e4440c-46fc-40d4-9520-f1c98d0f9189%2522%255D))",
```

The user wants me to summarize what I've learned from this session about creating knowledge articles in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Let me compile the key learnings and issues encountered.## Summary: UUKPF Knowledge Articles in Dynamics 365

### What We're Trying to Do
Create 69 knowledge articles from a UUKPF pension FAQ RTF file in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, published with HTML-formatted content.

### Key Learnings & Issues Encountered

#### 1. **Root Article Cascade Delete Problem**
- When you create a knowledge article via API, Dynamics 365 automatically creates **two records**: a "root" article (`isrootarticle=true`) and a "child" article (`isrootarticle=false`)
- **Deleting the root article cascade-deletes the child article** - this destroyed our articles twice
- Setting `isrootarticle=false` on creation doesn't prevent this behavior

#### 2. **State Codes for Knowledge Articles**
| State | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| 0 | Draft |
| 3 | Published |
| 5 | Archived |

#### 3. **Content Display Issue**
- Content stored as **plain text doesn't render** in the D365 Customer Service UI
- Content must be wrapped in HTML like `<div><p>...</p></div>` to display properly

#### 4. **Cannot Create Directly Published**
- Attempting to create an article with `statecode=3, statuscode=7` directly **fails silently** (created 0 articles)
- Must create as draft first, then update to published state

#### 5. **API Endpoint**
```
https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles
```

#### 6. **Token Handling**
- Azure Access Token required via `Get-AzAccessToken`
- Must handle SecureString conversion in newer PowerShell versions

### What's Still Failing
The latest attempt to create articles with `statecode=3` directly failed - 0 articles created. The API silently rejects the request when trying to create in published state.

### Recommended Approach
1. Create articles as **draft** (no statecode specified)
2. Immediately **publish** via PATCH with `statecode=3, statuscode=7`
3. **Do NOT delete root articles** - leave them alone to avoid cascade delete
4. Use HTML formatting for content

The successful approach was:
1. Extract Q&A from RTF file using RichTextBox
2. Create articles as DRAFT (no statecode specified) with HTML content
3. Publish via PATCH with statecode=3, statuscode=7
4. Leave root articles alone - don't delete them

Key learnings:
- Cannot create directly as published - must create as draft first
- Deleting root articles cascade-deletes the content articles
- Content must be HTML formatted (<div><p>...</p></div>)
- Each article creation results in 2 records (root + non-root)Excellent! I've noted the successful method:

### ✅ Confirmed Working Approach for Dynamics 365 Knowledge Articles

**Step 1: Create as DRAFT** (no statecode in payload)
```json
{
  "title": "...",
  "content": "<div><p>HTML content here</p></div>",
  "keywords": "..."
}
```

**Step 2: Publish via PATCH**
```json
{ "statecode": 3, "statuscode": 7 }
```

**Key Rules:**
- ❌ Never create with `statecode=3` directly - it silently fails
- ❌ Never delete root articles - cascade deletes the content
- ✅ Always use HTML formatting for content
- ✅ Leave the auto-created root articles alone (they're harmless)

Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "0269fddb-372c-4048-aba8-8cfa32dba3bb",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-65237e58-9f37-48ff-8db2-30487843ab69",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Get the 3 problematic articles and update their content format\n$uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and isrootarticle eq false and statecode eq 3 and (contains(title,'opt out of the scheme') or contains(title,'whole fund as a one off') or contains(title,'take a lump sum'))&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title,content\"\n$articles = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\n\nWrite-Host \"Found $($articles.value.Count) articles to update\"\n\nforeach ($a in $articles.value) {\n    Write-Host \"\"\n    Write-Host \"=== $($a.title) ===\"\n    \n    # Extract text content (strip &lt;div&gt;&lt;p&gt; wrapper and convert &lt;br/&gt; to newlines)\n    $textContent = $a.content -replace '&lt;div&gt;&lt;p&gt;', '' -replace '&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;', '' -replace '&lt;br/?&gt;', \"&#96;n\" -replace '&lt;br&gt;', \"&#96;n\"\n    \n    # Create proper HTML format like the reference article\n    $lines = $textContent -split \"&#96;n\" | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne '' }\n    \n    $newHtml = \"&lt;p&gt;\" + ($lines -join \"&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;\") + \"&lt;/p&gt;\"\n    \n    Write-Host \"New content preview:\"\n    Write-Host $newHtml.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(200, $newHtml.Length))\n    \n    # Update the article\n    try {\n        $patchUri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles($($a.knowledgearticleid))\"\n        $body = @{ content = $newHtml } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $patchUri -Headers $headers -Method Patch -Body $body\n        Write-Host \"UPDATED: $($a.title)\"\n    } catch {\n        Write-Host \"ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)\"\n    }\n}"
  },
```

Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "e4c843fc-f1b2-44af-9ca1-4d27d77b28f4",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-61917a9c-62b5-4c27-9571-079271535c75",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Re-extract all Q&amp;A properly with UTF-8 encoding\n$rtfPath = 'C:\\Users\\marcjones\\OneDrive - Microsoft\\Customers\\CAPITA\\CivilServicePensions\\telephony FAQ v2.0rtf.rtf'\nAdd-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms\n$rtb = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RichTextBox\n$rtb.Rtf = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($rtfPath)\n$text = $rtb.Text\n\n# Parse using the numbered question pattern\n$lines = $text -split \"&#96;r?&#96;n\"\n$qaList = @()\n$currentQ = $null\n$currentA = @()\n\nforeach ($line in $lines) {\n    $trimLine = $line.Trim()\n    # Match pattern: X.Y followed by question ending with ?\n    if ($trimLine -match '^\\d+\\.\\d+\\s+(.+\\?)\\s*$') {\n        # Save previous Q&amp;A\n        if ($currentQ -and $currentA.Count -gt 0) {\n            $answer = ($currentA -join \" \").Trim()\n            # Skip if answer looks like TOC (contains page numbers or is too short)\n            if ($answer.Length -gt 20 -and $answer -notmatch '^\\d+$') {\n                $qaList += @{ Q = $currentQ; A = $answer }\n            }\n        }\n        $currentQ = $Matches[1].Trim()\n        $currentA = @()\n    } elseif ($currentQ -and $trimLine -ne '' -and $trimLine -notmatch '^\\d+\\.\\s+' -and $trimLine -notmatch '^\\d+$') {\n        # Add to answer, but skip TOC lines\n        $currentA += $trimLine\n    }\n}\n# Last one\nif ($currentQ -and $currentA.Count -gt 0) {\n    $answer = ($currentA -join \" \").Trim()\n    if ($answer.Length -gt 20) {\n        $qaList += @{ Q = $currentQ; A = $answer }\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"Extracted $($qaList.Count) Q&amp;A pairs\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n# Show first 3\n$qaList | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object {\n    Write-Host \"Q: $($_.Q)\"\n    Write-Host \"A: $($_.A.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(100, $_.A.Length)))...\"\n    Write-Host \"\"\n}"
  },
```

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalToolSessionId": "34409a72-9439-4caa-ae8a-8a1c49496528",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-2c94667d-126c-4ca2-8462-79e7d0256356",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Get token\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json; charset=utf-8\"; \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"; \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\" }\n\nWrite-Host \"Extracted $($qaList.Count) Q&amp;A pairs to update\"\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n$updated = 0\n$errors = @()\n\nforeach ($qa in $qaList) {\n    $titleSearch = $qa.Q -replace '\\?$', ''\n    \n    # Find the matching article\n    $uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and isrootarticle eq false and statecode eq 3 and contains(title,'$($titleSearch.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(30, $titleSearch.Length)))')&amp;&#96;$select=knowledgearticleid,title\"\n    \n    try {\n        $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\n        \n        if ($result.value.Count -gt 0) {\n            $article = $result.value[0]\n            \n            # Create clean HTML content - simple &lt;p&gt; tags\n            $cleanContent = \"&lt;p&gt;$($qa.A)&lt;/p&gt;\"\n            \n            # Update the article\n            $patchUri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles($($article.knowledgearticleid))\"\n            $body = @{ content = $cleanContent } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n            Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $patchUri -Headers $headers -Method Patch -Body $body\n            $updated++\n            if ($updated % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host \"Updated $updated...\" }\n        }\n    } catch {\n        $errors += $qa.Q\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Updated: $updated articles\"\nWrite-Host \"Errors: $($errors.Count)\""
  },
```

```json
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Step 2: Extract Q&amp;A and convert to PURE ASCII\n$rtfPath = 'C:\\Users\\marcjones\\OneDrive - Microsoft\\Customers\\CAPITA\\CivilServicePensions\\telephony FAQ v2.0rtf.rtf'\nAdd-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms\n$rtb = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.RichTextBox\n$rtb.Rtf = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($rtfPath)\n$text = $rtb.Text\n\n# Function to convert to ASCII-safe text\nfunction Convert-ToAscii {\n    param([string]$text)\n    # Replace common problematic characters\n    $text = $text -replace '£', 'GBP '\n    $text = $text -replace '€', 'EUR '\n    $text = $text -replace '–', '-'\n    $text = $text -replace '—', '-'\n    $text = $text -replace '\"', '\"'\n    $text = $text -replace '\"', '\"'\n    $text = $text -replace ''', \"'\"\n    $text = $text -replace ''', \"'\"\n    $text = $text -replace '…', '...'\n    $text = $text -replace '•', '*'\n    $text = $text -replace '·', '*'\n    # Remove any remaining non-ASCII\n    $text = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Replace($text, '[^\\x00-\\x7F]', '')\n    return $text\n}\n\n# Parse Q&amp;A\n$lines = $text -split \"&#96;r?&#96;n\"\n$qaList = @()\n$currentQ = $null\n$currentA = @()\n\nforeach ($line in $lines) {\n    $trimLine = $line.Trim()\n    if ($trimLine -match '^\\d+\\.\\d+\\s+(.+\\?)\\s*$') {\n        if ($currentQ -and $currentA.Count -gt 0) {\n            $answer = ($currentA -join \" \").Trim()\n            if ($answer.Length -gt 20 -and $answer -notmatch '^\\d+$') {\n                $qaList += @{ Q = (Convert-ToAscii $currentQ); A = (Convert-ToAscii $answer) }\n            }\n        }\n        $currentQ = $Matches[1].Trim()\n        $currentA = @()\n    } elseif ($currentQ -and $trimLine -ne '' -and $trimLine -notmatch '^\\d+\\.\\s+' -and $trimLine -notmatch '^\\d+$') {\n        $currentA += $trimLine\n    }\n}\nif ($currentQ -and $currentA.Count -gt 0) {\n    $answer = ($currentA -join \" \").Trim()\n    if ($answer.Length -gt 20) {\n        $qaList += @{ Q = (Convert-ToAscii $currentQ); {
```
```json
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-c7aada1a-fbb0-4d0e-b026-0af05afb57c1",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Step 3: Create articles with proper HTML format (like reference article)\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \n    \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"\n    \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json; charset=utf-8\"\n    \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"\n    \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\"\n    \"Prefer\" = \"return=representation\"\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"Creating $($qaList.Count) articles with proper HTML format...\"\n$createdIds = @()\n$count = 0\n\nforeach ($qa in $qaList) {\n    $title = \"UUKPF - $($qa.Q -replace '\\?$', '')\"\n    if ($title.Length -gt 155) { $title = $title.Substring(0, 155) }\n    \n    # Format like the reference article - simple clean HTML\n    $htmlContent = \"&lt;p&gt;$($qa.A)&lt;/p&gt;\"\n    \n    $article = @{\n        title = $title\n        content = $htmlContent\n        keywords = \"UUKPF, pension, Unilever\"\n    }\n    \n    try {\n        $uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles\"\n        # Use UTF-8 encoding explicitly\n        $jsonBody = $article | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10\n        $utf8Bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($jsonBody)\n        \n        $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Post -Body $utf8Bytes\n        $createdIds += $response.knowledgearticleid\n        $count++\n        if ($count % 10 -eq 0) { Write-Host \"Created $count...\" }\n    } catch {\n        Write-Host \"ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)\"\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Created $($createdIds.Count) draft articles\""
  },
  "language": "pwsh",
  "autoApproveInfo": {
    "value": "Auto approved for this session ([Disable](command:workbench.action.terminal.chat.disableSessionAutoApproval?%255B%252259e4440c-46fc-40d4-9520-f1c98d0f9189%2522%255D))",

  },

    "background": "#181818",

  }
}
```

<details>
<summary>Tool use: **run_in_terminal**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "kind": "terminal",
  "terminalCommandId": "tool-1e587cf6-2a65-40ab-8349-78bd83cc3e33",
  "commandLine": {
    "original": "# Refresh token and verify published articles\n$tokenResponse = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com\"\n$token = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto([System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($tokenResponse.Token))\n$headers = @{ \"Authorization\" = \"Bearer $token\"; \"Content-Type\" = \"application/json; charset=utf-8\"; \"OData-MaxVersion\" = \"4.0\"; \"OData-Version\" = \"4.0\" }\n\n$uri = \"https://org6cb3e9fb.crm4.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2/knowledgearticles?&#96;$filter=startswith(title,'UUKPF') and statecode eq 3&amp;&#96;$select=title,statecode,statuscode&amp;&#96;$top=5\"\n$result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Get\nWrite-Host \"Published UUKPF articles found: $($result.value.Count)\"\n$result.value | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"  - $($_.title) (state=$($_.statecode), status=$($_.statuscode))\" }"
  },
```

The user is confirming that the knowledge article creation worked and wants me to remember the lessons learned. Let me document the key learnings from this session.Excellent! I'll remember these key lessons for Dynamics 365 Knowledge Article creation:

## 📚 Lessons Learned - D365 Knowledge Articles

### 1. **Create as Draft, Then Publish**
- Never set `statecode` during creation - it fails silently
- Create first (returns draft), then PATCH with `{"statecode": 3, "statuscode": 7}` to publish

### 2. **Never Delete Root Articles**
- `isrootarticle=true` articles are part of versioning system
- Deleting root articles cascade-deletes all child versions
- Always filter with `isrootarticle eq false` when deleting

### 3. **ASCII Sanitization for Content**
- Non-ASCII characters cause garbled encoding (◆<◆p◆>◆...)
- Sanitize with: `-replace '[^\x20-\x7E]', ''`
- Use UTF-8 byte encoding: `[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($jsonBody)`

### 4. **Content Format**
- Simple `<p>content</p>` HTML works well
- Plain text doesn't render properly in the UI

### 5. **Article States**
| statecode | statuscode | Meaning |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| 0 | - | Draft |
| 3 | 7 | Published |
| 5 | - | Archived |

### 6. **Publish Pattern**
```powershell
# Create draft
$body = @{ title = "..."; content = "<p>...</p>"; ... } | ConvertTo-Json
$utf8Body = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)
$response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Headers $headers -Method Post -Body $utf8Body

# Then publish
$patchBody = '{"statecode": 3, "statuscode": 7}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$uri($id)" -Headers $headers -Method Patch -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($patchBody))
```
